query:
WITH RECURSIVE task_ancestry AS (
                 SELECT id, parent_id
                 FROM tasks
                 WHERE id = $1 AND group_id = $2
                 UNION ALL
                 SELECT tasks.id, tasks.parent_id
                 FROM tasks
                 JOIN task_ancestry ON tasks.id = task_ancestry.parent_id
             )
             UPDATE tasks
             SET completed_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
             WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM task_ancestry)
               AND (completed_at >= coalesce(to_timestamp($3::bigint / 1000.0), '-infinity'))
                   IS TRUE
